name: BACH_0005_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section [F1] suggests medial and inferior margin involvement [F7] despite severity-3 blur.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Extreme score for invasive carcinoma |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th-percentile OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Unflagged despite extreme OOD blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (70%–78% similarity) [F5] | All neighbors invasive; Normal 69% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Below-typical score (-0.15) pushes toward invasive (+0.62) [F2]; 8/20 spot-checked · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.07, contrib +0.58) [F3]; failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.47, contrib +0.55) [F4]; caption-inconsistent; 18/20 spot-checked · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 4, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.24, contrib +0.52); weak concept, 0/20 spot-checked · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.72), small contribution (+0.05); 19/20 spot-checked · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and unreliable mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section blur (100th-percentile OOD) distorts tissue; reliability ranks errors imperfectly (AUROC 70%, n=1716).
- Blur obscures tubules or lobules, mimicking features separating this from contrast Normal case BACH_0157 (69% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 4, 9**: Highest risk (100%); verify stromal invasion in region 4 rather than unreliable mitoses.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 9**: Verify tumor at medial (215 um) and inferior (108 um) margins; stains blocked.
3. **Regions 1, 11**: Check whether scarce tubules and unreliable normal-lobule scores reflect severity-3 blur artifact.
